_doc: Carried lights and the Light spell (src/lights.py; Brandon 2026-11-19: ranged monsters shot from outside his sight, so a light in the off hand widens it, and the Light spell lasts a stretch of turns instead of lighting a spot). A light sits in the off hand where a shield would (it is not one: no AC, no plus, no block), so it cannot be held with a shield or a two-handed weapon. Lit, it adds its 'sight' to the hero's sight radius. Lights do not add up: the BRIGHTEST light the hero has counts (a carried light, the Light spell or a wand of light, a torch held as a weapon, an escort's lamp), and only one. Senses that are not light (dark vision, true sight, the Wild Road) add on top as before. The price: a lit hero is seen from farther, by the 'notice' of the brightest light (its sight unless its data says less: the dark lantern's shutter). Doused, a light gives nothing and costs nothing. The item data is data/items/light.json.
_doc_spell: The Light spell gives the hero the 'light' status for base_turns + turns_per_int for every point of Intelligence over 10 (never under min_turns), and a second cast adds to what is left, never past max_turns. The spell has no chain (v2.12.0); Intelligence is its reach, written here. A wand of light gives the status for its own 'power' in turns.
_doc_fuel: A torch burns itself away ('fuel': 'self'): when it is spent it is gone, and the next torch in the pack is lit at once. A lantern or a lamp burns oil ('fuel': 'oil'): when it runs dry the next flask of oil in the pack is poured in at once (oil_items), else it goes dark until filled (the Kit's Apply). 'burn' is the turns a fresh torch or a full lantern lasts; 0 means it never burns out. A light burns only while it is held and lit. low_share: below this share of its burn the sidebar shows how much is left, and the hero is told once.

lines.taken_up: You take up the {light} and light it.
lines.taken_up_dry: You take up the {light}. It is dry: fill it with a flask of fire oil.
lines.doused: You put out the {light}. The dark closes in, and you are harder to see.
lines.no_light: You hold no light. Shift+L takes one up from your pack.
lines.none_to_take: You carry no light that will burn.
lines.taken_up_wet: You take up the {light}. Its wick is too wet to light yet.
lines.two_hander_swap: Your weapon takes both hands. Ready a one-handed weapon (K, then R), and Shift+L will swap to it with the {light}.
lines.sidearm: You sling the {two_hander} at your back and draw the {weapon}, to free a hand.
lines.sidearm_back: You take the {two_hander} in both hands again.
lines.readied: Shift+L will take up the {light} first.
lines.unreadied: The {light} is no longer readied: Shift+L will take up your brightest.
lines.dry: The {light} is dry: fill it with a flask of fire oil (the Kit, Apply).
lines.next_torch: Your {light} gutters out. You light another ({left} left).
lines.last_torch: Your {light} gutters out. It was your last one.
lines.oil_refill: Your {light} runs dry. You pour in a flask of fire oil and it burns again.
lines.filled: You fill the {light} from a flask of fire oil.
lines.no_oil: You have no oil for it: a flask of fire oil fills it.
lines.spell: A steady light kindles about you: sight +{sight} for {turns} turns.
lines.spell_held: A light already burns about you for good.
lines.wand: Light pours from the wand and stays about you: sight +{sight} for {turns} turns.
lines.wand_reveals: In its light you see what hides from sight.
lines.way_down: The {light} burns toward the way down: the stair shows on your map.
lines.two_hander: You need a free hand for the {light}: your weapon takes both.

card.notice: Monsters see you from {notice} tiles farther while it burns.
card.notice_less: Its shutter throws the light ahead: monsters see you only {notice} tiles farther.
card.brightest: Lights do not add up: only your brightest light counts.
card.hand: Held in the off hand: not with a shield or a two-handed weapon.
card.burn_self: Burns {burn} turns, then it is gone ({left} left).
card.burn_oil: Burns lamp oil: {left} of {burn} turns left. A flask of fire oil fills it.
card.swap: Shift+L takes it up or puts it away in one turn, and your shield comes back by itself.
card.douse: Shift+O puts it out or lights it again, at no cost in time.

powers._doc: A named light's one power, by its data's 'power', while it is held and lit.
powers.shows_invisible: By its light you see invisible creatures.
powers.unmasks: By its light you see what lies in wait: ambushers and mimics show themselves.
powers.shows_way: It shows the way down: the down stair is on your map while it burns.

powers_short._doc: The same powers in a few words, for the Kit's table.

spawn._doc: Floor loot: each loot room has room_chance to hold a common light, chosen by each kind's floorSpawnWeight (about one a floor, like the flasks). The named lights roll with the other named uniques. Chests with a 'light' loot entry, the general traders and the sutler carry them too.
